title: TapTime IPC status v1
description: Connect to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/taptime/status.sock; server sends one JSON line and closes. Version 1. Successful snapshots cached in $XDG_STATE_HOME/taptime/status.json. Restarted snapshots are stale and frozen until sync. Monotonic extrapolation capped at 90 seconds. Unknown additive fields may be ignored.

sampled_at.description: UTC RFC3339 time when counters were sampled

last_sync.description: UTC RFC3339 time of last successful API read

stale.description: Failed synchronization, age over 90 seconds, or changed local date

date.description: Account local YYYY-MM-DD; null before first sync

worked_seconds.description: Closed work plus estimated current open session

presence_seconds.description: Local wall-clock presence from first check-in

presence_target_seconds.description: Core required day duration including lunch

balance_seconds.description: Positive overtime, negative undertime; TapTime balance rules

active.description: Open session on the current account-local date

local_time.description: Account timezone RFC3339, used for notification quiet hours.

month_balance_seconds.description: Current month signed balance, including local estimation of today's open session

first_check_in.description: First check-in of the account-local day, formatted HH:MM

last_check_out.description: Last check-out formatted HH:MM, null while session is open
